categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tianyishangjia High-tech Materials Corp., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: rail transit, photovoltaic new energy, automotive, and aerospace. The rail transit segment focuses on powder metallurgy brake pads for high-speed trains and synthetic brake pads for locomotives and urban rail vehicles. The photovoltaic new energy segment involves carbon-carbon composite materials and quartz crucibles for photovoltaic applications. The automotive segment develops high-performance carbon-ceramic brake discs and related components, while the aerospace segment produces resin-based carbon fiber composites and precision aerospace structural parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced powder metallurgy technology for manufacturing brake pads, including automated continuous pressing and sintering equipment. In photovoltaic materials, it uses intelligent multi-point needle punching for carbon fiber preforms and large-scale chemical vapor deposition (CVD) for carbon-carbon composites. Automotive carbon-ceramic brake discs are produced using near-net-shape preform preparation, chemical vapor infiltration, silicon infiltration, and ceramic coating technologies. Aerospace composites leverage hot pressing, molding, winding, and resin transfer molding (RTM) techniques, supported by finite element simulation platforms for design optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include China's National Railway Group and its regional subsidiaries, railway vehicle manufacturers such as CRRC, photovoltaic silicon wafer producers like LONGi Green Energy and JinkoSolar, automotive OEMs focusing on new energy vehicles and commercial vehicles, and aerospace entities including China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation and China Aviation Industry Corporation. The company serves industries in rail transit, renewable energy, automotive manufacturing, and aerospace defense.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with major facilities in Beijing, Sichuan (Jiangyou), Tianjin, and Jiangsu (Xuzhou). It also has expanding market presence internationally, including sales to Russian railways and Indonesian high-speed rail projects. Domestic sales dominate, with growing exports and overseas collaborations in rail and automotive sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianyishangjia operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures critical components such as brake pads, carbon composite materials, and precision aerospace parts, supplying directly to OEMs and system integrators. The company also controls upstream processes like carbon fiber preform production, enabling vertical integration in key product lines.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation and industrialization in green energy materials, focusing on upgrading carbon-ceramic brake materials, expanding carbon-based composites, and developing resin-based carbon fiber composites. R&D priorities include enhancing powder metallurgy brake pad performance, advancing carbon-carbon composite production automation, and developing new materials for photovoltaic and automotive applications. The firm invests heavily in intelligent manufacturing, digitalization, and large-scale production capabilities to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of brake pads, carbon composite materials, quartz crucibles, and aerospace structural components. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including participation in customer tenders, competitive negotiations, and strategic supply contracts. The company also benefits from government subsidies and occasional compensation income related to performance commitments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the rail transit brake pad market, Tianyishangjia holds a leading position with the largest market share and extensive CRCC certifications, competing with companies like Knorr-Bremse Suzhou and CRRC subsidiaries. In photovoltaic materials, it competes with firms such as Jinbo Co., Ltd. and Zhejiang Meijing. The automotive carbon-ceramic brake segment is emerging with limited domestic competitors, positioning Tianyishangjia as a pioneer. In aerospace composites, it competes with state-owned and private enterprises but is recognized for its independent R&D capabilities and growing influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.11 billion, representing a 113.82% year-over-year increase, driven mainly by growth in photovoltaic new energy products. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 144 million, down 18.9% year-over-year, impacted by pricing adjustments and impairment considerations. Total assets reached RMB 8.73 billion, up 27.1%, with net assets of RMB 5.22 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 7.06% of revenue, and is expanding production capacity across multiple segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianyishangjia differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, scale advantages, and integrated production capabilities across carbon-based materials. Its powder metallurgy brake pads are domestically leading, offering high reliability and safety for high-speed rail applications. The company’s carbon-carbon composites and quartz crucibles provide superior purity, durability, and cost-efficiency for photovoltaic and lithium battery industries. Its carbon-ceramic brake discs offer lightweight, high-performance solutions for new energy vehicles, enhancing safety and efficiency. The firm’s aerospace composites combine innovative materials and precision manufacturing to meet stringent defense and commercial aerospace requirements.
